editorial.marketOverview: The defensive three-day outlook remains anchored in Monday's QQQ 2.67% drop versus SPY around 1.90%, with large semiconductor losses and separately reported SOX weakness. Reuters' November 17 Asian session showed additional technology-heavy selling in Korea, Taiwan and Hong Kong, reinforcing risk aversion without proving the US cash market will extend lower.
editorial.whatChanged: Reuters documented regional tech weakness and expanded US restrictions on Chinese access to advanced AI chips through overseas data centres. These are fresh corroborating risk signals, but the incremental effect on US indexes and any independently attributable price reaction remain unverified. Open Watch's curated count and update timestamp are unchanged from the previous assessment.
editorial.marketInterpretation: An indicative 0.5% Nasdaq futures rise can coexist with a weak regional semiconductor tape after a sharp US selloff. Without synchronized US breadth, SOX and volatility observations it does not invalidate the bearish base case. Oil and yield estimates are not refreshed, and no Fed probability is invented.
editorial.threeDayPath: Tuesday November 17 retail sales at 08:30 ET and industrial production at 09:15 ET precede Nvidia results after the close. Wednesday November 18 housing starts and 14:00 ET FOMC minutes test rate expectations; Thursday November 19 will test whether semiconductors and breadth confirm a reversal or downside continuation. The direction of future event surprises and their actual equity responses remain unknown.
editorial.bullCase: An oversold rebound can become durable if QQQ and SOX rise together, participation broadens, VIX/VXN retreat and the Nasdaq-100 reclaims its 200-day moving average on confirmed prices. Favorable Nvidia guidance is a possible catalyst, not a known result.
editorial.bearCase: Further chip-led declines in Asia could spill into US trading, especially if Nvidia guidance disappoints, yields rise or the macro/FOMC combination reinforces restrictive Fed expectations. Regional moves alone do not establish causation or a confirmed US downside break.
editorial.watchNext: Verify timestamp-matched QQQ/NQ, SOX, VIX/VXN and breadth at the next US session; obtain paired official 2Y/10Y Treasury yields, current Brent/WTI and direct FedWatch pricing if available.
